scheme_name: Niji Talabon Ka Jirnoddhar Ki Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must be a private pond owner or lessee
Pond must not have been renovated under any government scheme in the last five years for Model‑1
Renovation of ponds constructed under government schemes is eligible only after five years of construction for Model‑2
benefits_summary: Provides subsidy for renovation of up to 150 hectares of private ponds, with 40% subsidy for extremely backward castes, scheduled castes and tribes, and 30% for other categories.
